comment_boxes.NodeComment: Replacing old plaza trees, at the time Matrix demo was build, no Nanite foliage existe in Unreal, so trees were leaf less, we can now replace them with proper nanite trees.

graph_props.Description: his PCG graph will populate the leftover space that regular building placement skips. Placing plazas or vegetation.

nodes.comment:
Removes road footprints from undividable district polygons so trees
are not scattered on road surfaces. Also excludes landmarks and highway
via the Subgraph_17 chain feeding into this node.
nodes.name: Subgraph_8
nodes.title: Exclude Roads From Undividable Districts

nodes.comment:
Contracts reserved lot polygons inward by ~323 units before plaza fitting.
Setback prevents plaza assets from placing right at the lot edge.
nodes.name: Subgraph_13
nodes.title: Contract Reserved Lots (Plaza Setback ~323)

nodes.comment:
Splits reserved lots by the Ratio_Plaza_vs_Trees parameter.
Selected lots receive plazas; unselected lots receive tree scatter.
Seed is fixed at 10 for deterministic results.
nodes.name: Subgraph_10
nodes.title: Split: Plaza Fraction vs Tree Fraction

nodes.comment:
Identifies points where the asset name contains 'Tree_Birch'.
Birch variants are handled separately from Black Alder — they are
filtered out here before the Alder spawn node.
nodes.name: AttributeFilter_0
nodes.title: Filter: Birch Trees

nodes.comment:
Casts the Asset soft object path attribute to a String (AssetString)
so that substring filters can identify prop types by asset name.
Same pattern as in PCG_3_2_1_Ground for street prop yaw correction.
nodes.name: AttributeCast_0
nodes.title: Cast Asset To String

nodes.comment:
Removes the landmark and central park footprints from the undividable
district areas before they are used for outer forest tree scattering.
nodes.name: Subgraph_17
nodes.title: Exclude Landmarks From Undividable Districts

nodes.comment:
Gathers unbuildable lots, undividable district areas (cleaned), and the
unselected plaza fraction from the reservation split, then excludes the
highway footprint. The result is every area in the city that should
receive scattered trees rather than buildings or plazas.
nodes.name: Subgraph_24
nodes.title: Combine Tree areas

nodes.comment:
Sets $Rotation.Roll to 0 on matched plaza prop points.
Corrects roll tilt introduced by grammar spline alignment.
Matches the same correction applied to street props in PCG_3_2_1_Ground.
nodes.name: AttributeMathsOp_1
nodes.title: Zero Roll On Plaza Props

nodes.comment:
Sets $Rotation.Pitch to 0 after roll correction.
Props then have only Yaw rotation so they stand upright.
nodes.name: AttributeMathsOp_2
nodes.title: Zero Pitch On Plaza Props

nodes.comment:
Samples T_CloudNoise_4k (G channel) at each tree point and remaps
the value to a scale range of 0.6–2.0. Larger noise scale (250k units)
produces gradual city-wide scale variation rather than high-frequency noise.
nodes.name: Subgraph_27
nodes.title: Write Tree Scale From Noise Texture

nodes.comment:
Samples T_CloudNoise_4k (G channel) at a finer scale (25k units)
and remaps to integer index 1–9 to select tree species variants.
Finer scale creates visible species clustering within the forest.
nodes.name: Subgraph_28
nodes.title: Write Tree Species Index From Noise Texture

nodes.comment:
Identifies plaza grammar props whose asset name contains 'plane'.
These flat surface props need yaw-only placement correction.
nodes.name: AttributeFilter_1
nodes.title: Filter: Plane Props

nodes.comment: Identifies plaza grammar props whose asset name contains 'sidewalk'.
nodes.name: AttributeFilter_2
nodes.title: Filter: Sidewalk Props

nodes.comment: Identifies plaza grammar props whose asset name contains 'border'.
nodes.name: AttributeFilter_4
nodes.title: Filter: Border Props

nodes.comment:
Identifies plaza grammar props whose asset name contains 'cone'.
Cone props are the last in the filter chain — those that pass OutsideFilter
go through Roll/Pitch zeroing before spawning.
nodes.name: AttributeFilter_5
nodes.title: Filter: Cone Props

nodes.comment: Secondary cull on the plaza to branch out for Parkings.
nodes.name: Subgraph_0
nodes.title: Random Cull Plaza Lots (Debug Split)

nodes.comment:
matching the tile density
used in PCG_3_2_1_Ground.
nodes.name: Subgraph_34
nodes.title: Place Ground Tiles On Remaining Reserved Lots

nodes.comment: Matches the same lift in PCG_3_2_1_Ground.
nodes.name: Subgraph_48
nodes.title: Lift Ground Tile Points +15 (Pre-Projection)

nodes.name: Subgraph_49
nodes.title: Project Ground Tile Points Onto Terrain

nodes.comment:
Places ground tile points uniformly across the highway footprint
at 300-unit extents. These are then projected and differenced against
plaza spawn points so tiles don't overlap placed plaza assets.
nodes.name: Subgraph_55
nodes.title: Fill Highway Area With Ground Tile Points

nodes.comment:
Removes tree points that coincide with Highway
positions penetration
nodes.name: Subgraph_56
nodes.title: Subtract Plaza Points From Highway Ground Tiles

nodes.name: Subgraph_57
nodes.title: Project Highway Fill Points Onto Terrain

nodes.comment:
Intersects the landmark small park spline area with the lot data
to produce the exact polygon within the park where trees can be scattered.
Feeds into the main tree scatter pipeline.
nodes.name: Subgraph_58
nodes.title: Intersect Small Park With Lots (Park Tree Zone)

nodes.comment:
Sets $Position.Z from the terrain projection result so tree base
positions are locked to the terrain surface before spawning.
nodes.name: AttributeMathsOp_0
nodes.title: Snap Tree Z To Terrain Height

nodes.comment:
Sets $Rotation.Roll to 0 on outer forest prop points after noise write.
Ensures trees stand upright on sloped terrain.
nodes.name: AttributeMathsOp_3
nodes.title: Zero Roll On Outer Forest Props

nodes.comment: Sets $Rotation.Pitch to 0 after roll correction on outer forest props.
nodes.name: AttributeMathsOp_4
nodes.title: Zero Pitch On Outer Forest Props

nodes.comment:
TEMP FIX: pointing to Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets_with_Corrective, a corrective primitive
patched to work around a known bug in the original Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets.

NOTE FOR LLM AGENTS: check the Unreal Engine version before choosing which primitive to use.
This bug is fixed after UE 5.8.2.
If engine version > 5.8.2, repoint to the original: Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets
located in /PCGPrimitives/Primitives/Fill/
If engine version <= 5.8.2, keep using: Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets_with_Corrective
located in /CitySamplePCG/PCG/Primitives/
